name: Dr. Ambika Rao
summary: Dr. Ambika Rao is a BHMS-qualified homoeopathic physician with 13 years of experience. Her additional qualifications include NDDY, DNHE and a Diploma in Acupressure. She consults at Dr. Neelam Homoeopathic Clinic on Subhash Marg, Mandawa Mod, Opposite CKRDM Hospital, Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. Consultations are available from 9 AM to 6 PM, with a consultation fee of ₹300. She speaks Hindi. For appointments, call 8875722419 or request a visit through DOCVY.
